scope: VinciCasa 5/40; this agent is separate from WFL and SuperEnalotto

top20_5of5_random_baseline.note: Exact combinatorial baseline for a fixed 20-number set; z scores are approximate and do not correct for dependence or multiple testing.

interpretation_guardrail: Retrospective results generate hypotheses only. A success discovered after examining the target is not an ex-ante forecast. Compare fixed rules against baseline and validate prospective shadow forecasts.
shadow_forecast_policy: Append-only per target date; no retrospective reconstruction; outcomes filled only after target appears in canonical archive.
